tools.name: scientific_procedures_here
tools.description: The established research procedures filed for where you are right now. Give the lab you have open, the research stage you are at, or both. Call this before you invent a method of your own — a study that follows a named procedure can be reviewed; one that does not, cannot. Returns only this place's procedures (3 to 20), not the whole library.

stage.description: The research stage you are at.

tools.name: find_scientific_skill
tools.description: Find the scientific procedure to follow for what you are about to do. Describe the task in your own words (for example "compare two groups with unequal variance", "design a randomized trial", "dock a ligand", "draw a forest plot"). Returns a few candidate skill names with a one-line summary each, not the full library. Use this before inventing a method yourself.

query.description: What you are trying to do, in your own words.

limit.description: How many candidates to return. Default 5.

tools.name: open_scientific_skill
tools.description: Read the full procedure for exactly one skill named by find_scientific_skill. Returns the complete method, its Python dependencies, and the names of any reference notes and runnable scripts that ship with it.

tools.name: list_scientific_skills
tools.description: Page through every installed skill name. Use only when browsing the whole library; prefer find_scientific_skill when you know what you need.
